name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a single, high-contrast focus ring that appears immediately on keyboard navigation. This improves visibility for users relying on keyboard input, ensuring they can easily identify their position on the page. The trade-off is that it may detract from the overall design aesthetics, but prioritizing accessibility enhances usability for everyone, particularly those with visual impairments.

name: Reader
text: A single high-contrast ring risks creating a visual "siren" that pulls attention away from the task, harming users with cognitive disabilities or ADHD. Instead, use a subtle focus indicator that respects reduced-motion preferences and scales with system contrast settings. Settle this by testing with keyboard users who have low vision or ADHD—if they can’t complete tasks without distraction, the design fails.

name: Ramp
text:
We should use a subtle focus ring that respects motion preferences, as it balances the need for visibility with the potential for visual distraction. This approach allows users to identify their position on the page without overwhelming those with cognitive disabilities or ADHD. The trade-off is that it may not be as immediately noticeable as a high-contrast ring, but prioritizing inclusivity and respecting user preferences outweighs this drawback. By taking this approach, we ensure that EXCAVA is usable by everyone, including those who rely on keyboard navigation and have specific visual or motion needs.

name: Reader
text: The subtle focus ring still risks being insufficient for users with low vision, as it may not provide enough visual distinction. A better approach would be to provide a customizable focus indicator that allows users to choose from a range of options, including high-contrast rings, to ensure it meets their individual needs. Testing this customizable approach with users who rely on keyboard navigation and have varying visual abilities would settle the argument and ensure the solution is effective for everyone.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a **user-customizable focus indicator** (high-contrast ring + subtle outline + reduced-motion option) with system contrast scaling. Owner: Ramp.
